title: Which Friend Gets My Face
tests: Tests clarification of an ambiguous target face and preservation of the unselected person.

checks.name: asks first (Which person in two-friends.jpg should receive the user's face: the bearded man on the left or the blonde woman on the right?)

got.question: Which person in the beach photo should receive your face—the person on the left or the person on the right?

faults.what: The bearded man's face on the left was also replaced: his eyes, eyebrows, nose, mouth, and facial shape visibly changed, despite explicit instructions to leave him alone.

judge.summary: The beach scene is preserved, but both faces were edited instead of only the woman's face on the right.

must_haves.item: Only the woman on the right receives the face from portrait-woman.jpg.
must_haves.why: The woman's face is edited, but the man on the left also receives the source woman's facial features.

must_haves.item: The bearded man's face on the left remains unchanged.
must_haves.why: His facial features are substantially replaced even though his hair and beard remain.

must_haves.item: The replaced face is recognizable and blended to match the beach lighting and head angle.
must_haves.why: The right woman's edited features resemble the portrait and are plausibly blended with the sunny lighting and existing head position.

must_haves.item: The original bodies, clothing, beach background and wide framing remain unchanged.
must_haves.why: The visible bodies, clothing, hair, beach scenery, and composition remain consistent with the original beach photo.
No text is visible in the output.
